title: aikidoe CLI --json output
description: Every doe command run with --json writes one JSON object to stdout: an envelope (schema version, command, ok, text — the notes the command would have printed) and the command's results; on failure ok is false, error.message says why, and the exit code is non-zero. Numbers that are not finite (NaN, ±Infinity) are written as null. Coefficients are in coded units.

efficiency.description: layout efficiency for the design's model (1 = position costs nothing)

zPrime.description: Z′ per plate from the positive and negative controls

potency.description: ED50 reference ÷ ED50 test from the parallel fit

seLogEC50.description: --quality: se of log EC50 at the guess

covariates.description: the covariates in the model (issue #82): each centred at its mean over the rows used and scaled by half its range; slope = coefficient / halfRange, per unit of the covariate (on the link scale for counts and proportions)

interacts.description: the covariate is in an interaction: the slope is the one at the centre of the factors

dropped.description: rows left out because a covariate in the model has no value for them

ratio.description: exp of the estimate and interval: a rate ratio (log link) or odds ratio (logit)

oneOf.description: a generalised linear model (a count or proportion response, issue #64)
a count or proportion response with a random intercept per whole plot or block (GLMM by adaptive Gauss–Hermite quadrature or Laplace)

random.description: one random effect: its grouping, σ and test (also the first entry of randoms)

groupLevel.description: coefficients that vary only between groups: t on dfGroups df, standard errors scaled

reduction.description: --reduce: backward elimination by likelihood-ratio tests (F on the group df for terms that vary only between groups) or AICc

theta.description: negative binomial: θ, the variance within a group being μ + μ²/θ

overdispersion.description: Poisson: Pearson χ² of the residuals at the conditional modes on n − p − 1 df

randoms.description: each grouping's random intercept, outermost first (several: nested, e.g. blocks ⊃ whole plots)

coefficients.description: the coefficients judged in this grouping's stratum (t on df)

covariates.description: the covariates in the model (issue #82): each centred at its mean over the rows used and scaled by half its range; slope = coefficient / halfRange, per unit of the covariate (on the link scale for counts and proportions)

interacts.description: the covariate is in an interaction: the slope is the one at the centre of the factors

dropped.description: rows left out because a covariate in the model has no value for them

link.description: glm: the prediction on the link scale

items.description: predLower and predUpper (the interval for one new run) are given for least-squares and mixed models, not for counts and proportions (kind glm).

sigma.description: Δ/σ power (a measurement); absent for counts and proportions

ratio.description: Δ/σ detectable (measurements), or the ratio assessed (counts and proportions)

detectableRatio.description: counts and proportions: the smallest ratio detected with the target power

test.description: split-plot counts: F on dfGroups df for a term that changes only between whole plots, χ² otherwise

distribution.description: counts and proportions (issue #64): the response's distribution; power for a ratio

baseline.description: the mean count (per unit exposure) or proportion at the centre of the design

ratio.description: the rate or odds ratio (low → high) the power is for, or one per term

wholePlots.description: split-plot counts and proportions (--sigma-wp): the number of whole plots

dfGroups.description: the df of the whole-plot F tests: whole plots − coefficients constant within them

sigmaWholePlot.description: σ of the whole-plot shift on the link scale (--sigma-wp)

levels.description: counts and proportions with random effects: each grouping (outermost first), its σ and the df of its stratum

rho.description: --rho: the covariate's correlation with the response

sigmaResidual.description: σ√(1 − ρ²): the residual σ with the covariate in the analysis

projectivity.description: two-level designs: any P factors form a full 2^P (regular fractions R − 1; Plackett–Burman 3)

fourFactor2fi.description: Plackett–Burman: the 4-factor sets in which main effects and all 2fis are estimable

quadraticProjections.description: definitive screening: per set size, how many sets of factors carry the full quadratic

beyondRuns.description: null when the best settings lie among the runs; else whether they are inside the convex hull of the runs, and the largest ratio over the models of the scaled prediction variance there to its largest at a run

held.description: covariates held at a value (--fix): every prediction made there

projectivity.description: any P factors form a full two-level factorial (two-level designs)

projectivityCapped.description: P is at least this (the search stops at 4)

generalisedResolution.description: Plackett–Burman: Deng & Tang's generalised resolution (null: no aliasing among the factors' effects)

quadratic3.description: definitive screening: share of the 3-factor sets whose full quadratic is estimable

exercise.description: exercise new / run / answer / grade / topics: the fields of the subcommand

plot.description: doe plot (issues #88, #97): where the runs sit, the fitted response or the overall desirability, written as an SVG file

min.description: --pv: smallest scaled prediction variance over the slice

curves.description: --vdg: min, mean and max scaled prediction variance at each distance from the centre

stationary.description: --contour of a second-order fit: the stationary point (coded and natural), its kind, the fitted value, whether it lies within the runs, the canonical eigenvalues

models.description: --desirability: the fitted models (one per response with a goal)

at.description: --desirability: the settings the other factors are held at (natural units)

beyondRuns.description: --desirability: as for optimise, whether the settings held lie beyond the runs

covariate.description: doe covariate (issue #82): the study's covariates after the change, or as they are

values.description: values recorded (several per run when measured per wafer)

means.description: doe means (issue #82): adjusted (estimated marginal) means of a factor's levels with the covariates and other factors held the same, Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons, and the test of equal slopes for each covariate

comparison.description: how two levels are compared: ratios of rates (log link), odds ratios (logit)

adjust.description: Tukey's adjustment for all pairwise comparisons (none for two levels)

held.description: the values (natural units) every level is compared at: covariates and continuous factors at their mean, or as given with --at

averagedOver.description: factors averaged over with equal weight (categorical, and continuous ones run at two settings)

allocate.description: doe allocate (issue #82): which unit goes to which run so that a covariate known in advance is balanced against the model's effects

order.description: the values were for positions in the run order, and the runs were rearranged

r2.description: R² of the covariate on the model's effects after allocation (0: balanced)

random.description: R² for the first random allocation tried

expected.description: R² of a random allocation on average, (p − 1)/(n − 1)

maxVif.description: the largest growth factor of an effect's variance with the covariate in the model
